notes.title: Content Update Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

This new update is a small content update meant to help fill out the world and make it feel a little more lively!

The two main additions in this update are:
[list]
[*] Chickens! I've added some small feathery friends to the main town to make it feel more populated. Don't worry, they're harmless (mostly).
[*] Goddess Statues. Now when you are exploring a dungeon, there is a high chance of a Goddess Statue appearing somewhere on the floor. Keep an eye out for them because they will give you a luck buff that provides double item drops for 30 seconds!
[/list]

Once again, thank you to everyone who is playing my game! If you have any feedback for bugs you've found or features you'd like to be added, please reach out to me on the official Discord server!

Happy Adventuring!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[b]New Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Remove level cap and allow infinite leveling
[*] Add new menu option to return to town while in dungeons
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix having to move to re-interact with shopkeepers
[*] Fix potion upgrades not saving correctly
[*] Selected potions and spells will now be remembered between levels
[*] Fix Minotaur not pausing attacks during boss fight while game is paused
[/list]

Thank you for all of your support! If you come across any bugs that I haven't addressed yet, please report them in the discord to help me get them resolved sooner!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you to everyone who has played my game! I greatly appreciate your support and I hope to make this game as enjoyable as possible for all of you.

Since release, there have been a few issues that have come to my attention and I've been putting out fixes for most of those that I am clumping together into version 1.0.1.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Shop menus not closing when pressing Escape
[*] Resolution issues causing arrow and spell aiming to be off
[*] Dialog sound not affected by sound volume setting
[*] Player dash ability randomly stops working
[*] Certain images blurring at higher resolutions
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes:
[/b][list]
[*] Increase enemy item drop rates
[*] Decrease potion crafting resource requirements
[/list]

More bug fixes and improvements will be coming soon. I also have plans for additional content once the game is stable.

If you find any other bugs, please report them in the official discord so that I can patch them as soon as possible!
